description: Begin or change an Alter integration. Without args: lists the phases. With `phase`: returns that phase's flows + a heuristic hint — classify the use case YOURSELF and call again with `goal` for the plan. If the use case spans multiple flows, run them sequentially.

goal.description: The flow id YOU classified. Returns that flow's full plan.

phase.description: setup (integrate from scratch) or modify (change an existing integration).

use_case.description: Plain-English description of what the developer wants.

name: get_started
